messages:
marta: Heads-up — EU-west embeddings+rerank queue spiking since ~06:22 UTC. p95 token latency up to ~1.8s, queue length ~420. Looks like one tenant's rerank jobs are pulsing.
ops-bot: [ALERT] service=embed-eu-west queue_depth=420 admission_control=triggered
raj: On it, grabbing logs. Any deploys/rollouts in the last hour? :thinking: 
kevin: No deploys. Infra alerted about repeated kernel OOMs on gw-eu-3 nodes around 06:18–06:24. Also saw brief packet loss spikes on that node pool.
sophia: EU currently shares one pool for both embeddings (low-latency) and rerank (high-throughput). We only have a dedicated rerank lane in us-east. Suggest temporary lane split in EU: carve a small low-latency lane for embeddings, and put rerank on degraded admission.
marta: Agreed. Short-term mitigations we can do now: tighten rerank admission_control, enable quantized fallback for embeddings, and route some rerank to us-east.
raj: Implementing: 1) set rerank_rate_limit=50rps 2) enable embed_fallback_model=emb-q8-v2 3) adjust smart-routing to send 20% rerank to us-east for the next 30m.
kevin: Pushed admission change and fallback flag. Redis config updated: `rerank_rate_limit=50`, `embed_fallback=emb-q8-v2`. Watching for config propagation.
marta: Also enabled prefix caching for top queries for that tenant, hoping to reduce duplicate work.
sophia: Quick note — I rolled back a recent autoscaler tweak that lowered min_instances for the shared pool from 8->6 earlier this morning; that contraction likely amplified the spike. Rolling back should give us headroom.
raj: Logs show backlog started draining after 06:40. p95 now ~420ms, queue ~30. Trending stable for now.
marta: Good. Postmortem actions: - per-lane autoscaler settings - regional reserved capacity for heavy rerank tenants - add SLA-tiered token priority / emergency rate bypass for paid customers
kevin: I'll draft an RFC for regional lane isolation and explicit lane configs (min_instances, eviction_policy, routing). Dropping note in eng-runtime.
sophia: Also request from finance: run a quick cost vs reserved-capacity calc for EU to compare burst egress vs small reserved pool.
raj: For observability: adding a dashboard that breaks queue depth by lane + by tenant, and an alert if rerank_share > 30% of total queue for 5m.
marta: Ops checklist posted in incident doc. Leaving fallback flags enabled for 15m, then revert if stable.
kevin: Code snippet I applied for admission (for posterity):
```yaml
admission_control:
  lanes:
    embeddings-lowlatency:
      rate_limit_rps: 200
      min_instances: 3
    rerank-high-throughput:
      rate_limit_rps: 50
      min_instances: 8
```
raj: Thanks — will validate metrics after 10m and then clear alert if stable. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> duration 00:48. :white_check_mark:
